# Comfy Seedance2.5 1080P- Text to Video

Generate cinematic 1080P video clips from text descriptions using Seedance 2.5, supporting clips up to 30 seconds with synchronized sound, music, and dialogue across any aspect ratio. Ideal for short comedy scenes, product showcases, and creative storytelling. Runs on Comfy Cloud and needs Comfy Cloud partner credits.

**How it works:** The Comfy nodes form the complete template graph. Run submits the graph to Comfy Cloud and saves its outputs.

**Try this:** Change the prompt or the Load node inputs and run again to compare results.

Source: https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/1ae390968e323dba24a6991d1860ded051f5a79b/templates/api_seedance2_5_t2v_1080p.json (MIT). Model licenses apply separately.

data.model.prompt: 1990s American courtroom drama scene, live-action, film grain, wood-paneled courtroom. A hippo lawyer in a pinstripe suit stands before the jury, slowly straightening his tie, then slams his paw on the table, making the water jug jump, and points dramatically at a tiny bird witness on the stand. He delivers his closing argument in slow motion, jowls wobbling with each word, then adjusts his glasses with a satisfied nod. Low angle heroic shot, dusty sunlight through blinds, tense 90s courtroom score, no black frames, no text overlays.
